name: Headline
overview: Dhaka, 2006. When a massive money-laundering exposé is wiped from existence, veteran journalist Jahir vanishes. To expose a high-level bank takeover, his protégé Samiul joins him to infiltrate an elite crime wedding for photographic proof.
